greet.speaker: Chancellor Alden
greet.text: Wrackmouth municipal records, salvage manifests, and maritime charters. All claims must be filed in triplicate.

choices.text: I'll leave you to your ledgers.

wrecks.speaker: Chancellor Alden
wrecks.text: Three merchant brigs broken upon the reef this harvest moon alone. The Mayor pays a fair salvage tally for iron and timber.
